name: Sea Bags
notes: Store meta: Portland, Maine, USD, ships to 28 countries incl. US, CA, GB, AU; 'Sea Bags Totes & Accessories are handcrafted in Portland, Maine ... made from recycled sail cloth' (https://seabags.com/meta.json).

Our stories: 'Handmade in Maine from Recycled Sails'; 'since we started in 1999'; reclaims 8,000–10,000 sails a year; an audit verified totes and bucket bags are 100% recycled sail content; 'Our Retail Stores' section describes its own stores (https://seabags.com/pages/our-stories-and-impact).

Returns within 60 days of purchase for a refund, by mail or at any Sea Bags retail location; customer pays return shipping unless defective (https://seabags.com/policies/refund-policy). No shipping-policy page (404); a current banner advertises $4.95 ground shipping through Nov 25, so no free-shipping threshold recorded.

Named: Navy Anchor on Chambray Medium Tote $175, Lupine on Sailor Stripe Essential Handbag $95 (single panel of recycled sail cloth, magnetic closure), bucket bags from $50, Heritage Aello Large Tote $495. Vendor 'Sea Bags' only; dog collars, ditty bags, pouches and beverage bags excluded.

prices.note: https://seabags.com/collections/bags/products.json feed, 599 listings: 7 marked down and 16 sold out excluded, 124 out-of-scope items excluded; 452 regular-price bags, median $180.
